g.title: guards
g.text: Live active reviewer; owns current desk
Active PDA locked for safe settlement

g.title: hold
g.text: Desk stays the same; no money movement
May be reviewed again without amendment

g.title: amend
g.text: Current hold required; active PDA locked

g.title: reset
g.text: Preserve bill number / stock / retry identity

g.title: reject
g.text: No register entry; no amendment allowed

g.title: refile
g.text: New bill identity and retry UUID
Rejected invoice can be filed again
